description: Extended configuration (NumCell 9, R_plunger 8 mm, NumTune 5) short-state sequence NumDepth 0.5-9.5, recomputed in CST 2026.5 from the round-07 B0 geometry seed with the automatic mesh policy (StepsPerBoxNear 10).
